svg.text: For a C3 POWER-RIGHT module only
Hold the module USB up, chip facing you: 5V, G and 3V3 must be the top
three pins of the RIGHT row. A power-left module here puts 5 V on a
GPIO pin and can destroy it. Check before you plug U1 in.
RP1 100 kΩ: F13, bottom − rail at
U1 ESP32-C3 Super Mini: C1-C8, G1-G8
copper strip: its holes are joined
a part on the board (see Parts)
a wire of an off-board device (see Device wires)
unmarked edge trace, broken at the link pads beside the M3 holes; the links join the halves
20 mm: printed at 100 % (actual size) this bar measures 20 mm and the board is real size
